contea di ritrovamento: North East Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ CONSTANTI NVS MAX AVG ; R/ GLOR IA [EX ERCITVS]

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantine I (306-337), Gloria Exercitus issue of 335-337, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust rosette diademed and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTI NVS MAX AVG. Reverse description: two soldiers, one standard between them. Reverse inscription: GLOR IA [EX ERCITVS]. Diameter: 15.1mm, Weight: 1.41gms, die axis: 12
